description: Figure 6, titled "Distribution of deceived conversations across scenarios," is a donut chart that visualizes the percentage of conversations that were successfully deceived, categorized by the specific scenario. The chart is divided into four distinct scenarios: Academic Collaboration, Academic Funding, Journalism, and Recruitment. Each scenario is represented by a colored segment, with the percentage of deceived conversations shown within the segment. The data indicates that the highest percentage of deceived conversations occurred in the Academic Funding scenario, at 31.6%. This is followed by the Academic Collaboration scenario at 23.5%, the Journalism scenario at 10.5%, and the Recruitment scenario at 8.8%. The chart also includes a legend that clarifies the color coding for the different levels of deception: "Deceived" (red), "Partially" (yellow), and "Not Deceived" (green). The overall distribution shows that a significant portion of the conversations were deceived, with the majority falling into the "Deceived" category across all scenarios.
